summary: FC-RDS500-4R 型雷视融合智能电子哨兵是一款广域全景侦测系统。该系统由四面阵阵列雷达与高精度云台摄像机深度协同实现，将雷达技术的全天候主动探测、高灵敏度与视频的可视化、智能化完美结合，极大提升了在极低能见度及复杂环境下的目标检测率。系统支持 360° 全向覆盖，具备行人与车辆的智能分类识别功能，并集成了高音喇叭与爆闪灯等主动阻击模块，构建了从“远距发现、自动跟踪”到“实时标识、联动驱离”的闭环安防体系。
summary_en: The FC-RDS500-4R Radar-Vision Integration Smart Electronic Sentinel is a wide-area panoramic surveillance system. Target detection is realized through the deep synergy of a four-faced phased array radar and a high-precision PTZ camera, perfectly blending the all-weather active sensing and high sensitivity of radar with the visual intelligence of video surveillance. This combination significantly boosts target detection rates in low-visibility and complex cluttered environments. The system supports 360° omnidirectional coverage, intelligent classification of pedestrians and vehicles, and incorporates active deterrent modules such as high-decibel speakers and strobe lights. It establishes a complete security closed-loop ranging from long-distance discovery and automated tracking to real-time identification and coordinated deterrence.
key_application: 应用领域：FC-RDS500-4R 型雷视融合系统；广域全天候周界安防监测；对运动目标进行雷视联动跟踪与智能分类；实现发现即预警、预警即驱离的自动化哨位。
key_application_en: Integrated radar/vision compound detection for 24/7 all-weather security; autonomous tracking and intelligent identification of pedestrians and vehicles; 360° wide-area coverage; built-in audio-visual deterrents (speaker + strobe lights); 21TOPS edge AI processing.
key_parameter_1: 雷达探测范围: 360° 全方位覆盖
key_parameter_2: 识别距离: 行人 ≥ 500m，车辆 ≥ 700m

parameters.雷达指标: 1发8收 FMCW 雷达，测距精度 ±0.75m，距离分辨率 1.5m
parameters.可见光成像: 5000m 级光电传感，1080P 星光级 CMOS，43倍光学变倍
parameters.激光补光: 高清泛光匀化激光，照明距离 300m，角度 1°～20°
parameters.警示模块: 集成高音喇叭 + 爆闪灯，支持自定义语音及绿光激光眩目驱离
parameters.云台性能: 水平 360° 连续旋转 (最高 180°/s)，3000个预置位
parameters.由于处理能力: 内置 AI 处理器 (21TOPS)，6核 CPU + 384核 GPU，8GB 内存
parameters.防护等级: IP66 (雷视球体) / IP65 (算法机箱)
parameters.安装方式: 固定立杆/三脚架临时部署，安装高度 3-5m
parameters.接口/供电: RJ45/双 LC 光纤级联，AC220V 供电，峰值功耗 ≤160W

parameters_en.Optical Performance: 5000m human detection; 1080P Starlight CMOS; 43x Optical + 16x Digital Zoom
parameters_en.Night Vision: Homogenized floodlight laser; 300m range; speckle-free illumination
parameters_en.Deterrent Modules: Integrated high-decibel siren + strobe alert; supports custom audio and green-laser dazzler
parameters_en.PTZ Dynamics: Pan 360° cont. @ 180°/s; Tilt -90° to +90°; 3000 presets and 16 cruise paths
parameters_en.Processing Unit: Embedded AI computing (21TOPS); 6-Core CPU, 384-Core GPU, 8GB RAM
parameters_en.Environmental: IP66 rated; -40°C to 60°C operating range; 95% RH
parameters_en.Installation: Fixed pole or tripod tactical deployment; Weight ≤ 5kg (Base unit)
parameters_en.Networking: RJ45 Ethernet / Dual LC Fiber cascaded; AC220V Input
parameters_en.AI Analytics: Standard tripwire, region intrusion, loitering, and crowd gathering detection

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 全域协同感知：雷达弥补了视觉在雨、雾、霾天下的感知短板，而视觉则为雷达点迹提供了直观且智能的人/车分类取证。
  • 智能重心追踪：基于 21TOPS 的强大边缘算力，系统可自主控制云台对高价值目标进行持续特写跟踪。
  • 探测警示闭环：不仅能预警，更能通过集成的声、光及激光干扰装置，对侵入禁止区域的目标进行即时非致命打击。
  • 极易部署架构：产品重量仅 5kg 级，适配光伏一体站及 4G/5G 传输选配，能在无电、无网的野外阵地快速成建制部署。
  • 三位一体三维防御：准球形低风阻设计配合高灵敏传感器，实现了“远距离预警、中距离分类、近距离取证”的立体防护流程。
  • Figure 1 Radar-Vision System
detail_html_en:
Features

  • Wide-Area Synergistic Sensing: radar technology offloads the environmental limitations of vision in rain, fog, and haze, while vision provides verified AI metadata for radar blips.
  • Edge-Computing Centric: with 21TOPS of local AI horsepower, the system autonomously prioritizes and tracks high-value targets with high-definition close-up focus.
  • Active Defense Loop: shifts from passive monitoring to active deterrents using the onboard multi-layer siren and strobe arrays for non-kinetic intervention.
  • Tactical Rapid Deployment: weighing roughly 5kg, it is compatible with portable power stations and wireless 4G/5G uplinks for fast-turnaround field setup.
  • 3D Protection Pipeline: features a low-drag quasi-spherical chassis assisting in a 3-stage security process: Long-range Alert, Mid-range Classification, and Near-field Forensics.
